source_text: Angelus: non extendas manum. Nunc cognovi quia times Deum. Timor perfectus dilectione.
pass_a_gloss: Angel: do-not extend hand. Now I-knew that you-fear God. Fear perfected by-love.
pass_b_english: [[Angel: Do not lay your hand on the boy >> Bible:Genesis 22:12]]. Now I know you fear God. Perfect fear is completed in love.
